column1: # B1162 item 1 (issue #481): RECORD 325, the Shadow Knight disciplines, on the
# B1143 (#463) ran this leg on class 4 and the Ti client swallowed every /disc
# (zero C->S OP_CastSpell). The lane's eqemu class table
# classes1..16, 0-based ^-split; record = field 145, spellsnew.eff) shows the
#   6299 Reaper Strike Recourse record 325  classcols = {} (no column)
#   6311 Lich Sting Recourse    record 325  classcols = {} (no column)
# So the OWNING class for the record-325 Leechcurse variants is class 5 =
# Shadow Knight (the B1143 "class 4 (Shadow Knight)" was actually Ranger).
# This leg switches char 67 to class 5 (SHD), levels it, trains disciplines,
# and runs the REAL client path /disc x3 (no GM #castspell -- the card forbids
# Activation = the REAL client path, /disc <name> (B1134 P4's working form:
# /disc sends OP_CastSpell slot 10 -> OP_Action with NO OP_BeginCast).
# #resetdisc_timer all between casts (B1134 P4b: the single 10-minute reuse
# timer rejected casts 2..4 of P4). The observer view is measured against
# B1130 rows 325/326 and the B1143 item-3 instrument to state whether the
